description_en: Queries the details of a specified rule template
description_zh: 查询指定规则模板的详细信息
name: GetManagedRule

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the rule template.

For more information about how to obtain the rule template identifier, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421144.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则模板标识。

关于如何获取规则模板标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421144.html
parameters.name: identifier

ManagedRule.description_en: The details of the rule template

CompulsoryInputParameterDetails.description_en: The information about the required input parameters for the rule template
CompulsoryInputParameterDetails.description_zh: 规则模板的必填参数信息

ConfigRuleName.description_en: The name of the rule template

Description.description_en: The description of the rule template
Description.example: CDN域名开启HTTPS协议加密，视为“合规”。

HelpUrls.description_en: The URL of the document that provides guidance on how to fix the issue
HelpUrls.description_zh: 规则模板修正指导的文档链接

Identifier.description_en: The identifier of the rule template

Labels.description_en: The labels of the rule template

items.description_en: The label of the rule template

OptionalInputParameterDetails.description_en: The information about the optional input parameters for the rule template
OptionalInputParameterDetails.description_zh: 规则模板的可选参数信息

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule template. Valid values:

1: high risk.

2: medium risk.

3: low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则模板的风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

Scope.description_en: The effective scope of the rule template

ComplianceResourceTypes.description_en: The resource types for which the rule template is effective
ComplianceResourceTypes.description_zh: 规则模板生效的资源类型列表

items.description_en: The resource type for which the rule template is effective
items.description_zh: 规则模板生效的资源类型

SourceDetails.description_en: The trigger methods for the rule
SourceDetails.description_zh: 规则触发方式信息列表

MaximumExecutionFrequency.description_en:
The execution period of the rule. Valid values:

One_Hour: 1 hour.

Three_Hours: 3 hours.

Six_Hours: 6 hours.

Twelve_Hours: 12 hours.

TwentyFour_Hours: 24 hours
MaximumExecutionFrequency.description_zh:
规则执行周期。取值：

One_Hour：1小时。
Three_Hours：3小时。
Six_Hours：6小时。
Twelve_Hours：12小时。
TwentyFour_Hours：24小时

MessageType.description_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: The rule is triggered by a configuration change.

ScheduledNotification: The rule is triggered periodically
MessageType.description_zh:
规则触发机制。取值：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行
